en: who served alongside Tim Keller for 38 years.
"Pastor, is Jesus Christ your true joy?
Or is Christ a tool for preaching and church growth?"
Is Christ really the joy of your life?

text:
삶이 무너졌을 때
너무 바쁠 때
en: When it falls apart, when you're swamped,
a deep joy that can't be taken even then.
That's the joy that keeps you standing.

text:
좀 힘들면 다 무너지고
좀 어려우면 다 무너지고
en: If you crumble whenever things get hard,

text:
그러면 그리스도가 정말
기쁨이 되지 못하는 거죠
en: then Christ isn't really your joy.
Then your foundation was laid wrong.

text:
지금까지의 신앙이
뭔가 잘못 이루어진 거예요
en: Something in your faith so far went wrong.
Tear it down and build it again.
